calls.statement:
WITH m AS (SELECT member_id, min(join_date) AS jmin, max(join_date) AS jmax, min(valid_from) AS vf, count(*) AS n FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE jmin='2026-09-25') AS first_join_925,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE jmax='2026-09-25') AS last_join_925,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE jmin<>jmax) AS changing_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE n>1) AS multi_version,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE vf='2026-09-25') AS first_valid_925,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date='2026-09-25') AS stg_925,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE join_date='2026-09-25' AND member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)) AS stg_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE join_date='2026-09-25' AND member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date='2026-09-25')) AS stg_id_in_dim
